crossRefs.note: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities, until he came to Caesarea.
Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and…
Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.
But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem, and…

When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia…
Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger…

So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

people.name: Antioch
people.line: A major city where the gospel spread to Gentiles.

people.name: Caesarea
people.line: Coastal city, center of Roman rule in Judea
